owner_boundary: Railway owns terminal deployment state only. Grafana owns dashboard availability, pipeline freshness, database pressure, grouping, repeats, and resolved notifications.
activation_gate: Do not send Railway events directly to #bonaparte-alerts until either an existing operated receiver proves exact production environment and dashboard/worker service filtering, or the Railway project contains only production and only those two services.

delivery.reason: Railway project webhooks span every environment and direct Slack does not implement the simulated environment/service filter. Enable only through an existing operated filtered receiver, or after proving the project contains production alone and only dashboard/worker; otherwise keep Railway notifications email/in-app.

events.runbook_action: Inspect build and deploy logs, then fix forward or redeploy the last known-good image. Do not mutate queue history or raw telemetry.
